name: MCI (Partner)
desc:
Remote Mortgage Customer Service Representative | $12.10 to $16.10/hr + Bonuses | Inbound Calls, No Sales Expectations
Company: MCI (Marlowe Companies Inc.)
Industry: Call Center-Multiple Industry

What Your Day Will Look Like:
MCI handles customer service for other companies, and this team supports mortgage customers for one of MCI's clients. You'll take inbound calls from homeowners across the country, listen to what they need, and solve their account questions. You'll use the knowledge base and your training to give accurate answers, follow the client's scripts and steps for money-related questions, and escalate issues when needed. You'll keep customer records up to date in the CRM and note how each call was resolved, all while working across several screens at once. You'll talk with hundreds of customers each week, so a positive, steady attitude matters.

Soft Skills
- Patience and empathy
- Active listening
- Multitasking across screens
- Problem solving
- Reliability and good attendance
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment. You must complete the full application, all screening questions, and a brief pre-employment test. Typing requirement: 30 to 45 words per minute, typed quickly and accurately. Practice a typing test before applying.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED
Required Experience: None. Entry level, 0 years required, and MCI provides paid training.
Preferred Experience: Banking or financial services, and computer data entry

Required Skills:
- Must be 18 or older
- Type 30 to 45 words per minute accurately
- Read and speak English fluently
- Multitask across several screens while talking with customers
- Comfortable with Windows and learning new computer systems
- Basic Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint
- Strong written and verbal communication
- Reliable attendance and punctuality

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Wants a first call center job with paid training
- Has banking, finance, or customer service experience
- Types well and is comfortable with computers
- Has a clean background and can pass a drug screen

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has a felony on their record
- Needs to start at $16/hr or more
- Types under 30 words per minute
- Struggles with strict scripts and attendance rules
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit the full application on MCI's careers page, including all screening questions
2. Complete the brief pre-employment test (includes typing)
3. If the test passes, expect a recruiter to reach out by email or text for a phone screen
4. If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average. Offers depend on a Level II background check with fingerprints and a drug screen.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Inbound customer service
- Call center
- Mortgage or financial services
- First call resolution
- CRM documentation
- Multitasking across systems
- Typing speed and accuracy
- Confidential information handling
- Microsoft Office
- Attendance and reliability

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about any customer service or banking experience you have.
- A homeowner is upset about their mortgage payment. How do you handle the call?
- How do you keep track of information when you're working on several screens at once?
- Tell us about a time you solved a problem for someone on the first try. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you had to follow strict rules or steps at work. What was the situation, how did you handle it, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $12.10 to $16.10/hr based on experience, plus daily, weekly, and monthly contests with cash bonuses and prizes.
-Shift: Multiple schedules available. Discussed in the interview or upon offer. Must have full availability because each position and client has different needs.
-Benefits: PTO and paid holidays. Full-time employees get medical, dental, and vision after 60 days, and everyone can get a basic MEC medical plan after 30 days. Also retirement savings where available, short-term disability, life insurance, accident and critical illness insurance, and paid training.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: No. This role requires up to a Level II background and security check with fingerprints.
-Drug Test: Required. Job offers depend on passing a drug screen.
-Notes: The posting lists the location as Oklahoma statewide, work from home. Pay starts low for most hires, so set expectations before referring. The pre-employment test includes typing at 30 to 45 WPM. MCI's biggest bottleneck is applicants not finishing the assessment, so make sure participants complete it. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Mortgage Customer Service Representative → Senior Customer Service Representative → Team Lead → Supervisor → Trainer or Operations Management. This role builds financial services, call handling, and CRM skills.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
